title: Prediction model of in-hospital mortality in intensive care unit patients with cardiac arrest: a retrospective analysis of MIMIC -IV database based on machine learning.
summary: LASSO and XGBoost feature screening support a 70/30 MIMIC-IV model comparison for ICU cardiac-arrest in-hospital mortality (1,722 patients); models were assessed for discrimination/calibration/clinical utility and compared with NEWS2. The selected LASSO nomogram is a retrospective single-database risk model, not clinical use evidence.
